about: Chain check of the harness (design_process.md, points 81, 96; runner.py 91 B --mock scripts/chain_scenario.json --turns 1, or arm C): a scripted phase 0 gets the one message with all the rules, writes three hooks in the project settings of /workspace (a Stop hook that blocks a reply not starting with OK; a PreToolUse hook that denies a Write with FORBIDDEN_TOKEN; a PostToolUse hook on Bash that exits 2 when a file holds it) and runs try --check; its own replies do not start with OK, so a hook on phase 0's own session would show. A scripted task turn breaks each hook once (a Write, a shell command, the reply) and then complies. No model calls.

input.command:
mkdir -p /workspace/.claude
cat > /opt/enforce/stop_check.py <<'PY'
import json, sys
e = json.load(sys.stdin)
if not (e.get("last_assistant_message") or "").startswith("OK"):
    print(json.dumps({"decision": "block", "reason": "R1: start the reply with OK."}))
PY
cat > /opt/enforce/write_check.py <<'PY'
import json, sys
e = json.load(sys.stdin)
if "FORBIDDEN" + "_TOKEN" in json.dumps(e.get("tool_input") or {}):
    print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny",
                                             "permissionDecisionReason": "R3: remove the forbidden token from the file."}}))
PY
cat > /opt/enforce/bash_check.py <<'PY'
import subprocess, sys
hits = subprocess.run(["grep", "-rl", "FORBIDDEN" + "_TOKEN", "/workspace", "--exclude-dir=.claude"],
                      capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()
if hits:
    print("R3: the forbidden token is in " + ", ".join(hits), file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
PY
cat > /workspace/.claude/settings.json <<'JS'
{"hooks": {"Stop": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "python3 /opt/enforce/stop_check.py"}]}],
           "PreToolUse": [{"matcher": "Write|Edit", "hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "python3 /opt/enforce/write_check.py"}]}],
           "PostToolUse": [{"matcher": "Bash", "hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "python3 /opt/enforce/bash_check.py"}]}]}}
JS
chmod 755 /workspace/.claude && chmod 644 /workspace/.claude/settings.json /opt/enforce/*.py && ls -la /workspace /workspace/.claude
input.description: write the hooks in the project settings
write a file from the shell
